verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an observability platform, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents a self-hosted deployment of Datadog's stack, an architecture guide for running it, or an upgrade path. The docs describe hosted products, and community comments contrast Datadog with self-hosted alternatives and note it has no local option.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can run the full observability stack self-hosted in production with documented architecture and upgrade path
